capabilities.does: Opts a mesh into Nanite rendering. The switch sits in the mesh editors, on the FBX import dialog, and in a batch command in the Content Browser menu. Project-wide Nanite settings live under Rendering.
capabilities.inputs: Enable Nanite Support (mesh editor), Build Nanite (FBX import), Nanite > Enable (Content Browser batch)
capabilities.outputs: Mesh drawn through the Nanite path

capabilities.does: Nanite meshes support up to 16 million streamed-in instances. Tangents are not stored per vertex; the pixel shader derives them. Needs DirectX 12 with Shader Model 6 on current consoles and desktops.
capabilities.inputs: Static Mesh or Geometry Collection with Nanite on
capabilities.outputs: High-triangle-count geometry on screen without hand-made LODs

capabilities.does: Nanite is the engine virtual geometry system. Static Mesh, Skeletal Mesh, Instanced and Hierarchical Instanced Static Mesh, Spline Mesh, Geometry Collection, Foliage Painter and Landscape Grass components can use it.
Skeletal meshes can use Nanite through a separate checkbox. They cost one draw call per mesh, receive Virtual Shadow Map shadows, and use animation LODs because they have no geometry LODs.
capabilities.inputs: Enable Nanite Support on a Skeletal Mesh

capabilities.does: Ray tracing sees a fallback mesh in place of the Nanite mesh by default. Lowering Fallback Relative Error keeps more source triangles in it. The console variable r.RayTracing.Nanite.Mode 1 tries native Nanite ray tracing (experimental).
capabilities.outputs: Simplified proxy geometry for ray-traced effects

capabilities.does: Nanite Tessellation displaces surfaces at runtime from a displacement map or a procedural material. The related offline route, Nanite Static Displacement Mapping, bakes displacement into an optimised mesh in the Static Mesh Editor.
capabilities.inputs: Displacement map or procedural material; tessellation and displacement scalars (page does not name them)

capabilities.does: Nanite materials support Opaque and Masked blend modes. Other blend modes fall back to a default material with a log warning. Mesh decals are out because they need Translucent; projected decals work. Morph targets and Wireframe are unsupported.
capabilities.inputs: Material Blend Mode: Opaque or Masked
capabilities.outputs: Materials accepted by the Nanite path

capabilities.does: World Position Offset works on Nanite meshes with limits. The page advises clamping displacement to keep cluster culling effective. Rigid translation, rotation and non-uniform scale are also supported.
capabilities.inputs: World Position Offset in the material; displacement clamp
capabilities.outputs: Animated vertex motion on Nanite meshes

capabilities.does: The page lists three supported uses: Nanite Foliage, Nanite with Landscapes, and Nanite Splines (Landscape Splines and Blueprint Splines). It gives no further detail.
capabilities.outputs: Nanite-rendered foliage, terrain and spline meshes

capabilities.does: Not supported with Nanite meshes: Minimum Screen Radius and distance culling, Forward Rendering, stereo VR rendering, MSAA, and Lighting Channels. Some visualisation modes also skip Nanite meshes.

Lumen is the dynamic global illumination and reflection system. It is the default for new projects. Turning it on hides lightmaps and disables precomputed static lighting. Two project settings, Dynamic Global Illumination Method and Reflection Method, choose it separately.
capabilities.inputs: Dynamic Global Illumination Method = Lumen, Reflection Method = Lumen

capabilities.does: Lumen software ray tracing traces against distance fields and needs Generate Mesh Distance Fields. Software Ray Tracing Mode picks Detail Tracing (per-mesh distance fields, best quality) or Global Tracing (global distance field, faster).
capabilities.inputs: Software Ray Tracing Mode, Generate Mesh Distance Fields, Distance Field Voxel Density

capabilities.does: Lumen can use hardware ray tracing on a supported GPU, RHI and OS. Support Hardware Ray Tracing enables it; Use Hardware Ray Tracing when available falls back to software otherwise. Ray Lighting Mode picks Surface Cache or Hit Lighting for Reflections.
capabilities.inputs: Support Hardware Ray Tracing, Use Hardware Ray Tracing when available, Ray Lighting Mode
capabilities.outputs: Higher-quality Lumen traces on RT GPUs

capabilities.does: Lumen reflections are set per Post Process Volume: Quality, Ray Lighting Mode, Screen Traces, High Quality Translucency Reflections, Max Roughness To Trace, Max Reflection Bounces (default 1, up to 8) and Max Refraction Bounces. r.Lumen.Reflections.MaxBounces overrides to 64.
capabilities.inputs: Quality, Max Roughness To Trace, Max Reflection Bounces, Max Refraction Bounces, Screen Traces

capabilities.does: Post Process Volume controls for Lumen GI: Lumen Scene Lighting Quality, Lumen Scene Detail (smallest instance size tracked), Lumen Scene View Distance, Final Gather Quality, Screen Traces, Max Trace Distance. Higher values cost more GPU time.
capabilities.inputs: Lumen Scene Lighting Quality, Lumen Scene Detail, Lumen Scene View Distance, Final Gather Quality, Max Trace Distance

capabilities.does: Advanced Lumen GI controls: Lumen Scene Lighting Update Speed, Final Gather Lighting Update Speed, Diffuse Color Boost (values under 2 advised), Skylight Leaking and Full Skylight Leaking Distance. These trade cost for responsiveness or give art-directed bounce and sky light.
capabilities.inputs: Update Speed sliders, Diffuse Color Boost, Skylight Leaking
capabilities.outputs: Art-directed bounce light and faster light propagation

capabilities.does: With Lumen GI, Material Ambient Occlusion needs Allow Static Lighting off. Bent Normal maps need r.GBufferDiffuseSampleOcclusion=1 and the Bent Normal custom output; they cost far more than Material AO for little gain.
capabilities.inputs: Allow Static Lighting, Material AO output, Bent Normal custom output

capabilities.does: Lumen drops static lights (their contribution is disabled), carries notable scene-update cost above about 100,000 instances with hardware tracing, only the top clear coat layer can look sharp, and tiny bright emissive areas give noise.

Virtual Shadow Maps give each light a virtual map of 16k x 16k texels, split into 128x128 pages allocated where needed. Shadow Map Method in the project settings or r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable switches them on. r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxPhysicalPages sets the page pool.
capabilities.inputs: Shadow Map Method, r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable, r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxPhysicalPages, r.Shadow.Virtual.NormalBias
capabilities.outputs: High-resolution shadows for Nanite and normal geometry

capabilities.does: Directional lights use clipmaps: each level has its own 16k map and covers twice the radius of the last. Default levels 6 to 22 reach from 64 cm to about 40 km. Clipmap.FirstLevel and LastLevel set the range.
capabilities.outputs: Sun shadows from close-up to far

capabilities.does: Spot lights use one 16k virtual map with a mip chain; point lights use a cube map of 16k maps, one per face. ResolutionLodBiasLocal and MarkPixelPagesMipModeLocal tune cost. No per-light resolution control exists.

Soft shadows use Shadow Map Ray Tracing. Source Radius (local lights) and Source Angle (directional lights) set penumbra size. RayCount and SamplesPerRay variables for local and directional lights set noise and softness; 0 rays gives hard shadows.

Page caching is on by default; r.Shadow.Virtual.Cache 0 disables it. Static and dynamic depth are cached apart. Each primitive has Shadow Cache Invalidation Behavior: Auto, Always, Rigid or Static. World Position Offset Disable Distance and Displacement Fading cut invalidation.
capabilities.inputs: Shadow Cache Invalidation Behavior, World Position Offset Disable Distance, r.Shadow.Virtual.Cache
capabilities.outputs: Cheaper shadows for mostly static scenes

capabilities.does: Coarse pages give low-resolution shadow data to volumetric fog and translucency (MarkCoarsePages variables, First/LastCoarseLevel). r.Shadow.Virtual.TranslucentQuality above 1 gives high-quality shadows on lit translucent surfaces at high cost.
capabilities.outputs: Shadows on fog and translucent surfaces

capabilities.does: r.Shadow.Virtual.Visualize shows modes mask, mip, vpage, cache, naniteoverdraw, raycount and clipmapvirtual. Layout, light selection variables, stats (r.Shadow.Virtual.Stats) and Insights traces help find page-pool and cost problems.

The path tracer is a reference renderer in the editor and Movie Render Queue. Post Process Volume PathTracing settings: Max. Bounces, Samples Per Pixel (ignored by MRQ), Max Path Intensity, Emissive Materials, Reference Depth of Field, Reference Atmosphere, Lighting Components.
capabilities.inputs: Max. Bounces, Samples Per Pixel, Max Path Intensity, Emissive Materials, Reference Depth of Field, Reference Atmosphere

capabilities.does: A denoiser plugin cleans the last sample. NNE Denoise (default, Intel Open Image Denoise-based network on GPU), NFOR (temporal, default), Open Image Denoise (CPU) and OptiX (NVIDIA, experimental). r.PathTracing.Denoiser toggles it; Denoiser.Name picks the spatial one.

In Movie Render Queue the path tracer total samples per pixel equals Spatial Sample Count times Temporal Sample Count. Reference Motion Blur takes all temporal samples before denoising. High Resolution tiles can extend output beyond what one GPU pass allows.
capabilities.inputs: Spatial Sample Count, Temporal Sample Count, Reference Motion Blur

capabilities.does: Path tracer cost and look controls via console variables: r.PathTracing.CompactionDepth (default 6), ShaderExecutionReordering, DispatchSize (2048), FlushDispatch, MultiGPU, ApproximateCaustics (on), EnableEmissive, VisibleLights, LightFunctionColor.

Volumes in the path tracer: Volumetric Fog and Exponential Height Fog are supported; Volumetric Clouds and Heterogeneous Volumes only partly. r.PathTracing.CloudMultipleScatterMode 2 gives true multiple scattering, slower. Sparse Volume Textures partly supported.
capabilities.outputs: Fog, cloud and smoke in reference renders

capabilities.does: r.PathTracing.ApproximateCaustics (default 1) approximates caustics to cut noise in the path tracer.

Path-traced shading models listed as supported: Unlit, Default Lit, Subsurface, Preintegrated Skin, Alpha Holdout, Clear Coat, Subsurface Profile, Two Sided Foliage, Hair (experimental), Cloth, Eye, SingleLayerWater (experimental), Thin Translucent. Substrate is initial and experimental.

Limits: HDRIBackdrop is not compatible (use a Sky Light with r.PathTracing.VisibleLights 2); moving lights and animated meshes do not reset accumulation in the viewport; base colours near 1.0 slow rendering, under 0.8 advised.
Substrate replaces fixed shading models with a layered, principled Slab BSDF. Inputs include Diffuse Albedo (default 0.18), F0, F90, Roughness, Anisotropy, Emissive Color, Normal and Tangent.
capabilities.inputs: Diffuse Albedo, F0, F90, Roughness, Anisotropy, Emissive Color, Normal, Tangent

capabilities.does: Substrate is Unreal Engine 5 material authoring that replaces fixed shading models and blend modes with a modular framework. The landing page labels it Beta and advises caution when shipping with it.

Slab subsurface inputs: SSS MFP (mean free path in cm per colour channel, used when no Subsurface Profile is set), SSS MFP Scale, SSS Phase Anisotropy. The Sub-Surface Type property selects Wrap, Two-Sided Wrap, Diffusion or Simple Volume.
capabilities.inputs: SSS MFP, SSS MFP Scale, SSS Phase Anisotropy, Sub-Surface Type

capabilities.does: A fuzz layer models fabric-like retroreflection. Inputs are Fuzz Roughness, Fuzz Amount and Fuzz Color.
capabilities.inputs: Fuzz Roughness, Fuzz Amount, Fuzz Color

capabilities.does: Slab Anisotropy runs from -1 (bitangent) to 1 (tangent) and aligns the highlight; Tangent input supplies the direction.
Second Roughness and Second Roughness Weight add a second specular lobe and set its mix with the primary one.
Glint Density and Glint UVs control sparkling micro-facet glints. They need r.Substrate.Glints=1.
Substrate Simple Clear Coat is a fast top coat built on a Slab, aimed at legacy Clear Coat materials. Substrate Vertical Layer is the general way to stack coats such as car paint or varnish.
capabilities.inputs: Substrate Simple Clear Coat; Vertical Layer

capabilities.does: Special nodes used alone, not mixed: Eye BSDF, Hair BSDF, SingleLayerWater BSDF, Unlit BSDF (coloured transmittance instead of grey opacity) and Volumetric-Fog-Cloud BSDF for clouds and heterogeneous volumes.
capabilities.inputs: Substrate Eye, Hair, SingleLayerWater, Unlit, Volumetric-Fog-Cloud nodes
capabilities.outputs: Eyes, hair, water, unlit and volume materials

capabilities.does: Operators combine slabs: Vertical Layer (top over bottom, Top Thickness), Horizontal Blend (Background, Foreground, Mix), Coverage Weight (Weight), Add (not physically plausible), Select (one of two paths). Use Parameter Blending merges slabs to cut lighting cost.
capabilities.inputs: Top Thickness, Mix, Weight, Use Parameter Blending

capabilities.does: Extra output nodes make a Substrate graph a Light Function, a Post Process material, a UI material for UMG, or a decal (Convert To Decal, needs a compatible translucent blend mode).
capabilities.inputs: Substrate Light Function, Post Process, UI, Convert To Decal

capabilities.does: Project settings include Substrate GBuffer Format (Blendable or Adaptive), Closure Per Pixel (with override), rough reflection and rough refraction toggles, and layer support (one-way). Console: r.Substrate.BytesPerPixel (default 80), MaxClosureCount, BlendableGBuffer.
capabilities.inputs: GBuffer Format, Closure Per Pixel, r.Substrate.BytesPerPixel, r.Substrate.MaxClosureCount
capabilities.outputs: Quality versus memory budget for materials

capabilities.does: Post Process Volumes group effects into categories: Exposure, Bloom, Color Grading, Film, Lens (flares, chromatic aberration, vignette, film grain), Ambient Occlusion, Screen Space Reflections, Depth of Field, Motion Blur. Camera-related settings are set mainly on a Cinematic Camera Actor.
capabilities.inputs: Post Process Volume or camera post process
capabilities.outputs: Image look applied per volume or camera

capabilities.does: Motion Blur settings: Amount (0 off), Max (cap as a share of screen width), Target FPS (0 uses the measured rate) and Per Object Size (minimum on-screen size, default 4 percent).
capabilities.inputs: Amount, Max, Target FPS, Per Object Size
capabilities.outputs: Blur from camera and object motion

capabilities.does: Lens Flare settings: Intensity, Tint, BokehSize (share of view width), Threshold, BokehShape (cannot be blended) and Tints (per-flare colour and position).
capabilities.inputs: Intensity, Tint, BokehSize, Threshold, BokehShape, Tints

capabilities.does: Film Grain settings: Film Grain Intensity, per-range Intensity (Shadows, Midtones, Highlights), Shadows Max and Highlights Max limits, Texel Size and Film Grain Texture.
capabilities.inputs: Film Grain Intensity, Intensity Shadows/Midtones/Highlights, Texel Size, Texture

capabilities.does: Chromatic Aberration has Intensity (RGB colour fringing) and Start Offset (normalised distance from frame centre where it begins).
Vignette Intensity darkens the frame corners; 0 means none.
Screen Space Reflections settings: Intensity, Quality (softness of transitions) and Max Roughness (roughness at which reflections fade out).
The Film category shapes the tone curve: Slope (S-curve steepness), Toe (dark response), Shoulder (bright response), Black Clip and White Clip.
capabilities.inputs: Slope, Toe, Shoulder, Black Clip, White Clip

capabilities.does: Color Grading is split into colour temperature control, colour balance for global, shadows, midtones and highlights, and miscellaneous options such as expanded gamut and LUTs. The page names no finer parameters.

Screen-space ambient occlusion has Intensity and Radius, plus advanced Static Fraction, Radius in WorldSpace, Fade Out Distance, Fade Out Radius, Power, Bias, Quality, Mip Blend, Mip Scale, Mip Threshold and Temporal Blend Weight.

Cinematic Depth of Field targets desktop and console; Mobile Depth of Field is a cheaper Gaussian option. Cinematic Camera Actor settings (focus, aperture) drive it. The exposure category sets method and adaptation speed over time.
capabilities.inputs: Camera aperture and focus; DOF method

capabilities.does: CineCamera Actor Filmback presets set Sensor Width and Height (mm), which fix base field of view and a read-only Sensor Aspect Ratio. Lens Settings presets set Focal Length, FStop and Diaphragm; Min/Max Focal Length equal values act as a prime.
capabilities.inputs: Filmback preset, Sensor Width/Height, Lens Settings preset, Min/Max Focal Length, Min/Max FStop
capabilities.outputs: Real-camera field of view and framing

capabilities.does: CineCamera has a Squeeze Factor for anamorphic lenses and Diaphragm Blade Count, which shapes bokeh (fewer blades gives squarer bokeh, more gives rounder).

Focus Method options: Do Not Override, Manual, Tracking, Disable. Manual Focus Distance is in cm with an eyedropper. Tracking uses Actor to Track, Relative Offset, Focus Offset; Smooth Focus Changes and Focus Smoothing Interp Speed ease changes. Debug focus plane shows the focus depth.
capabilities.inputs: Focus Method, Manual Focus Distance, Actor to Track, Smooth Focus Changes, Draw Debug Focus Plane

capabilities.does: Crop Settings: No Crop, 1.33, 1.77, 2.39 or Custom (Cropped Aspect Ratio). Look at Tracking aims the camera at an actor with Relative Offset, Look at Tracking Interp Speed and Allow Roll. Current Focal Length, Aperture and Horizontal FOV are shown read-only.
capabilities.inputs: Crop Settings, Enable Look at Tracking, Look at Tracking Interp Speed, Allow Roll

capabilities.does: A Level Sequence asset holds tracks, cameras, keyframes and animation; a Level Sequence Actor binds it to a level. The actor has playback settings Auto Play, Loop, Play Rate, Start Offset, Random Start Time, Restore State and Pause at End.
capabilities.inputs: Level Sequence asset; Level Sequence Actor playback settings

capabilities.does: Level Sequence Actor cinematic settings: Disable Movement Input, Disable Look At Input, Hide Player, Hide Hud, Disable Camera Cuts. Disabling camera cuts stops the sequence from controlling the camera.
capabilities.inputs: Disable Movement Input, Disable Look At Input, Hide Player, Hide Hud, Disable Camera Cuts

capabilities.does: The Camera Cuts track picks the active camera over time. Create Camera adds a Cine Camera Actor with its own track and makes the Camera Cuts track if missing. Drag a cut edge to trim a shot; the plus button adds a binding.
capabilities.inputs: Create Camera, Camera Cuts track, New Binding, Lock Viewport

capabilities.does: Anti-Aliasing module: Spatial Sample Count (accumulated renders per temporal sample), Temporal Sample Count (time slices per frame), Override Anti-Aliasing with None, FXAA or TemporalAA (MSAA unsupported). r.TemporalAASamples defaults to 8.
capabilities.inputs: Spatial Sample Count, Temporal Sample Count, Anti Aliasing Method

capabilities.does: Warm-up settings build up temporal history and let physics or particles settle before output: Use Camera Cut for Warm Up, Render Warm Up Frames, Render Warm Up Count, Engine Warm Up Count.
capabilities.inputs: Render Warm Up Count, Engine Warm Up Count, Use Camera Cut for Warm Up

capabilities.does: High Resolution tiling renders images larger than the GPU allows. Tile Count, Overlap Ratio (reduces seams, costs time), Texture Sharpness Bias, Override Sub Surface Scattering and Burley Sample Count. Tiling does not work with TAA history.
capabilities.inputs: Tile Count, Overlap Ratio, Texture Sharpness Bias, Burley Sample Count

capabilities.does: Camera settings in Movie Render Queue: Shutter Timing places blur after (Frame Open), centred (Frame Center) or before (Frame Close) the frame; Overscan Percentage renders extra pixels outside the frame for EXR work; Render All Cameras.
capabilities.inputs: Shutter Timing, Overscan Percentage, Render All Cameras

capabilities.does: The Console Variables list sets named variables when a render starts and restores them after. Start Console Command and End Console Commands run commands before and after.
capabilities.inputs: Console Variables entries, Start Console Command, End Console Commands

capabilities.does: Game Overrides raise quality while rendering: Game Mode Override, Cinematic Quality Settings, Texture Streaming, Use LODZero, Disable HLODs, Use High Quality Shadows, Shadow Distance Scale, Shadow Radius Threshold, View Distance Scale.
capabilities.inputs: Use LODZero, Disable HLODs, Shadow Distance Scale, View Distance Scale

capabilities.does: Output module: Output Directory, File Name Format (tokens, slashes make folders), Output Resolution, custom frame rate, Zero Pad Frame Numbers, Frame Number Offset, Handle Frame Count, Output Frame Step, custom playback range, Auto Version, Version Number.
capabilities.inputs: Output Directory, File Name Format, Output Resolution, Output Frame Rate, Handle Frame Count

capabilities.does: Render passes: Deferred Rendering (with Detail Lighting, Lighting Only, Reflections Only, Unlit views), Path Tracer, Object Ids, World Depth, Motion Vectors, Stencil Layers, UI Renderer, VT Pending Mips.
capabilities.inputs: Pass selection; Additional Post Process Materials

capabilities.does: Object Ids are written in the Cryptomatte specification, with Id Type: Full (default), Material, Actor, Actor With Hierarchy, Folder or Layer. Needs the Additional Render Passes plugin; experimental, editor-only; at least 8 spatial samples.
capabilities.inputs: Id Type, Spatial Sample Count >= 8, Disable Multisample Effects

capabilities.does: The .exr sequence output can write all passes into one multilayer EXR (Multilayer). Disable Tone Curve outputs linear HDR for post. World Depth stores depth in the red channel; Motion Vectors store per-pixel motion centred at 0.5.
capabilities.inputs: Multilayer, Disable Tone Curve, Use 32Bit Post Process Materials

capabilities.does: Movie Render Graph output nodes: PNG, JPG, BMP, EXR, EXR Multilayer, WAV, Apple ProRes (Quality 422 Proxy to 4444 XQ, Windows) and Avid DNxHR (Quality options, Windows). Movie nodes embed timecode.
capabilities.inputs: Output node type, Quality, OCIO option

capabilities.does: Movie Render Graph per-layer renderers: Deferred Renderer (Spatial Sample Count, AntiAliasing Method, Disable Tone Curve, Allow OCIO, View Index Mode, 32-bit output, Render Show Flags) and Path Traced Renderer (adds Denoiser, Reference Motion Blur, NFOR Frame Count).
capabilities.inputs: Render Layer, Deferred Renderer, Path Traced Renderer properties

capabilities.does: Collection nodes group actors by condition groups (Add, Subtract, And). Modifier nodes control Is Hidden, Cast Shadows, Cast Shadows While Hidden, Affect Indirect Lighting While Hidden and Holdout for a collection.

Graph globals include Warm Up Settings, Global Game Overrides, Global Output Settings (timecode), Sampling Method, Camera Settings, Debug Settings (Insights traces, RenderDoc), CVar presets, Command Line Encoder (FFmpeg), Execute Script (Python class MovieGraphScriptBase), Burn-In, UI Renderer, Subgraphs.
capabilities.inputs: Globals, Execute Script, Command Line Encoder, Subgraphs

capabilities.does: Niagara systems hold emitters; emitters hold stacked modules. Parameters live in namespaces System, Emitter, Particle, Engine and User. Modules are node graphs with optional HLSL. Stages: Spawn, Update, Event, plus Simulation Stages on the GPU.
Simulation Stages run several Spawn and Update passes in sequence on the GPU, which suits fluid simulations. Stack groups System, Emitter and Particle decide what data each module can read and write.

Lightweight (stateless) emitters, added in UE 5.4, cut tick cost by being fixed-function. Supported modules include Gravity Force, Drag, Curl Noise, Initialize Particle, Shape Location, Sub UV Animation and size or colour scaling. No custom modules or dynamic inputs.

Niagara Fluids templates: 2D Gas, 2D Liquid, 3D Gas, 3D Liquid, Shallow Water. 3D Gas emitters run a grid simulation; options include grid world size and Resolution Max Axis, open boundaries, vorticity confinement, pressure iterations, dissipation, buoyancy and gravity.
capabilities.inputs: Grid3D_Gas emitters; Resolution Max Axis, Pressure Solve Iterations, Vorticity Confinement, Gravity

capabilities.does: 3D Gas turbulence parameters (Seed Turbulence Gain/Frequency/Speed, Turbulence Density/Temperature Gain and Band, Frequency/Speed/Bias) and sources: Particle Attribute Reader reads another emitter; scatter density, temperature, velocity; Use Radius; multipliers; Splat Size.
capabilities.inputs: Turbulence Gain, Frequency, Speed; Scatter Density/Temperature/Velocity; Use Radius

capabilities.does: 3D Gas rendering parameters: Render Step Size Mult, Render Density (None, Linear, Curve), Density Range and Gain, Albedo, Shadow Quality and Max Steps, Render Temperature (None, Black Body, Curve) with range, curve and gain. Two lights are read via data interface.
capabilities.inputs: Render Density, Render Temperature, Shadow Quality, Lgt1/2 Default Intensity/Color/Direction

capabilities.does: The CINE 3D Gas explosion emitter adds a noise texture with Texture Smoke/Fire Density and Color Gain, Texture Scale, Remap To 0/1, Value Data, Value Band Min/Max/Sharpness and Loop Duration, plus a debug view.
capabilities.inputs: Texture Scale, Value Band, Loop Duration

capabilities.does: Chaos rigid bodies cover collision responses and presets, damping, friction, asynchronous simulation, networked physics, Physical Materials and Physics Sub-Stepping. Chaos Visual Debugger records and replays simulations frame by frame or sub-step.
capabilities.inputs: Collision presets, Physical Material, Physics Sub-Stepping

capabilities.does: Physics Constraints connect physics objects to each other and to the world. The Physics Asset Editor sets up bodies and constraints on Skeletal Meshes for ragdoll physics.
Chaos Vehicles simulate vehicles with any number of wheels, gears, aerofoils and thrust forces, with an asynchronous physics mode for determinism.
Chaos Cloth simulates cloth with wind and other forces, exposes parameters to Blueprints and has an Animation Drive system.

Fracture Mode tools: Uniform (Voronoi), Cluster, Radial, Planar, Slice (Slices X/Y/Z, Random Angle/Offset Variation), Brick (experimental; Bond, Length, Height, Depth), Mesh (Cutting Actor; Single Cut, Uniform Random, Grid) and Custom (Pattern, Normal Offset, Variability, Skip Fraction).
capabilities.inputs: Min/Max Voronoi Sites, Number of Cuts, Slices X/Y/Z, Brick dimensions, Cutting Actor

capabilities.does: Cluster tool: Min/Max Num Clusters, Sites per Cluster, Dist from Center, Radius Offset. Shared options: Random Seed (-1 is new each time), Chance to Fracture, Group Fracture, Grout, and Perlin noise (Amplitude, Frequency, Persistence, Lacunarity, Octave Number, Point Spacing).
capabilities.inputs: Random Seed, Chance to Fracture, Grout, Amplitude, Frequency, Octave Number

capabilities.does: Geometry Collections are the destruction asset made from a Static Mesh Actor. Fracture creates a hierarchy of bones per level; View Settings include Explode Amount, Hide UnSelected and Fracture Level; Reset reverts to pre-fracture.
capabilities.inputs: Fracture Mode, Explode Amount, Fracture Level, Reset

capabilities.does: Physics Fields apply forces, break clusters, or anchor and disable fractured bodies inside a region of space. Chaos Destruction also has damage thresholds, connection graphs and a cache.

Control Rig events: Forwards Solve (default, controls drive the skeleton), Backwards Solve (bones drive controls, used for baking), Construction Event (runs once, spawns elements, default procedural element limit 128), and Backwards and Forwards for debugging bakes.
capabilities.inputs: Events > Backwards Solve, solve direction dropdown
capabilities.outputs: Rigs usable in Sequencer and AnimBP

capabilities.does: Bake To Control Rig transfers animation from a Sequencer character track onto a rig that has a Backwards Solve. Options: Export Transforms, Export Curves, Record in World Space, Evaluate All Skeletal Mesh Components, Warm Up Frames, Delay Before Start, Reduce Keys, Tolerance.

Rig element types: Control, Bone and Null. Controls drive bone chains and can carry custom channels. Animation types: Animation Control, Animation Channel, Proxy Control (drives listed controls), Visual Cue. Nulls group elements for mirroring.

Control value types: Bool, Float, Integer, Vector 2D, Position, Scale, Rotator and Euler Transform (default). Float, Integer and Vector 2D default to 0 to 100. Transform Limits per axis with Draw Limits; rotation shown as Euler, Quaternion or Axis and Angle.
capabilities.inputs: Value Type, Min/Max limits, Control Enum

capabilities.does: The Procedural Content Generation Framework docs cover PCG Editor Mode, Shape Grammar, GPU Processing, runtime generation and debugging, Biome Core and Sample plugins, and the Procedural Vegetation Editor (Nanite-ready plants).
Sampler nodes: Copy Points, Mesh Sampler, Texture Sampler, Select Points, Spline Sampler, Surface Sampler, Volume Sampler.
capabilities.inputs: Surface, spline, volume, mesh, texture data

capabilities.does: Spawner nodes: Create Target Actor, Point from Player Pawn, Spawn Actor, Static Mesh Spawner (one mesh per point, picked by weight or attribute).

Filter nodes include Attribute Filter, Density Filter, Point Filter, Self Pruning and filters by tag, type or index. Metadata nodes create, copy, rename, noise, partition and operate on attributes, with Maths, Boolean, Compare, Rotator, Transform, Trig and Vector op groups.

Spatial nodes: Create Points Grid, Create Spline, Polygon 2D tools, Projection, Union, Intersection, Difference, Spatial Noise, World Ray Hit Query, World Volumetric Query, Get Landscape Data, Get Spline Data, Merge Points, Offset Polygon.

Control Flow nodes: Branch (Boolean attribute to output A or B), Select, Select (Multi), Switch (integer, string or enum). Generic nodes include Gather, Get Loop Index, Proxy, Add/Delete/Replace Tags.

Landscape Edit Layers stack non-destructive terrain data. Layer types: Layer, Splines Edit Layer, Patches Edit Layer. Heightmap Alpha and Weightmap Alpha blend; Max Number of Layers defaults to 8. Actions: lock, hide, delete, rename, Collapse, Collapse All Layers, Clear.
capabilities.inputs: Heightmap Alpha, Weightmap Alpha, Max Number of Layers, Collapse

capabilities.does: Blueprint brushes are stored per edit layer; Assign Existing Brush reattaches one. Erase Tool reverts sculpting on a layer. Layer Contribution (Lit > Visualizers) highlights what a layer adds.
capabilities.inputs: Blueprint brush, Erase Tool, Layer Contribution

capabilities.does: The Water plugin has spline-driven bodies: Ocean (closed loop, far horizon), Lake (closed loop, carves terrain), River (open spline, depth, width, velocity), Custom (Static Mesh), Island, and Exclusion Volume. Water Mesh Actor and Water Zone make the surface; Far Distance Mesh fills to the horizon.
capabilities.inputs: Spline points: Depth, River Width, Velocity; Water Zone; Far Distance Mesh Extent

capabilities.does: Terrain settings: Use Curve Channel, Elevation Curve Asset, Channel Edge Offset, Channel Depth, Curve Ramp Width, Blend Mode (Alpha Blend, Min, Max, Adaptive), Falloff Mode, Blurring, Curl Noise, Displacement, Smooth Blending, Terracing, Affects Landscape.
capabilities.inputs: Elevation Curve Asset, Blend Mode, Falloff Angle/Width, Terrace Spacing

capabilities.does: Waves Source defaults to Gerstner Waves or can use a Water Waves Asset. Wave Attenuation Water Depth and Max Wave Height Offset tune them. River to Lake and River to Ocean transition materials; Underwater Post Process Settings with Priority, Blend Radius and Blend Weight.
capabilities.inputs: Waves Source, Wave Attenuation Water Depth, Blend Radius, Blend Weight

capabilities.does: The Groom Asset Editor has panels for Hair Groups, Level of Detail, Interpolation (movement under skinning and physics), Strands, Cards, Meshes, Materials and Physics. Detailed properties sit on linked pages.
capabilities.inputs: Groom asset; LOD, Interpolation, Strands, Cards, Meshes, Materials, Physics panels

capabilities.does: Geometry Script function libraries create and edit UDynamicMesh objects from Blueprints and Python. The target mesh is the first argument and is returned for chaining; settings sit in Options structures. Functions convert to and from static mesh, skeletal mesh and volume geometry.

Datasmith imports whole scenes. Direct readers: Autodesk Alias, Inventor, AutoCAD (beta), CATIA V5, SOLIDWORKS (beta), Cinema 4D, Rhinoceros 3dm, Creo, Siemens NX, IFC, IGES, JT Open, Parasolid, Siemens PLM XML, STEP, 3DXML. Export plugins serve 3ds Max, Revit, Navisworks, VRED, Archicad, SketchUp, CityEngine.

Mass Entity is a data-oriented framework: Fragments (data), Tags, Entities, Archetypes, Processors (logic), Traits grouped in MassEntityConfig assets, a MassEntity Manager, MassCommandBuffer, EntityView and EntityQuery.

Interchange import options: Force All Mesh as Type, Import Lods, vertex colour handling, mesh Build options (Recompute Normals/Tangents, MikkTSpace), static mesh Collision prefixes (UBX_, UCP_, USP_, UCX_), Build Nanite, Generate Lightmap UVs, Lod Groups.
capabilities.outputs: Static meshes with collision and LODs

capabilities.does: Skeletal import: Import Content Type, Combine Skeletal Meshes, Import Morph Targets, Create Physics Asset, Bone Influence Limit. Animation import: Animation Length, bone-track sampling rate, curves, Remove Redundant Keys. Import Into Level takes FBX, glTF, GLB and MaterialX.
capabilities.inputs: Import Skeletal Meshes, Import Animations, Animation Length

capabilities.does: Material and texture import: Import as Material or Material Instance with a Parent Material, Detect Normal Map Texture, Flip Normal Map Green Channel, Import UDIMs, long-lat cubemaps, Allow Non Power of Two.
capabilities.inputs: Material Import, Parent Material, Import UDIMs

capabilities.does: The USD Stage Actor holds a loaded USD file in the level. Stage editor features: layers, prims, variants, purposes (Default, Proxy, Render, Guide), render contexts, UsdLux lights, UsdPreviewSurface and MDL materials, animation as Level Sequence tracks, live updates when the file changes.
capabilities.inputs: USD file; Set Root Layer, Set Purpose to Load, Set Render Context
capabilities.outputs: Native USD scene in the editor

capabilities.does: Pixel Streaming runs the app on a server, encodes frames and audio, and streams to browsers over WebRTC. A signalling and web server negotiates connections and serves the player page. Keyboard, mouse, touch and custom events return to Unreal Engine.
capabilities.outputs: Interactive stream in a web browser

capabilities.does: nDisplay renders one scene across synchronised machines: primary and secondary nodes, viewports, projection policies, an application window, a config asset edited in the 3D Config Editor, Switchboard launching, failover policy, Multi GPU Mode with GPUIndex, ICVFX inner frustum.
capabilities.inputs: Config Asset, Output Mapping, projection policy, GPUIndex

capabilities.does: Unreal Insights shows traces in Timing Insights (CPU, GPU, I/O and Asset Loading tracks), Networking Insights and Slate Insights. Channels set what is traced. Command line: -trace, -tracefile, -statnamedevents; console: Trace.Start, Stop, Pause, Status.

World Partition splits a level into grid cells loaded by streaming sources. Settings: Enable Streaming, Is Spatially Loaded, Runtime Grid, Cell Size, Loading Range, Block on Slow Streaming, Priority. Includes One File Per Actor and a Build Minimap command.
capabilities.inputs: Cell Size, Loading Range, Is Spatially Loaded, Streaming Source component

capabilities.does: HLOD layer types: Instancing (instanced meshes at lowest LOD), Merged Mesh (one proxy mesh), Simplified Mesh (merged then reduced). Settings include Always Loaded, Cell Size, Loading Range, Parent Layer, HLODMaterial; Build > Build HLODs or the WorldPartitionHLODsBuilder commandlet.

Merged Mesh settings: Generate Lightmap UV, Merge Physics Data, Merge Materials, Gutter Size, LODSelection Type, Use Texture Binning, Include Imposters, Allow Distance Fields, Generate Nanite Enabled Mesh. Simplified Mesh adds Screen Size, Merge Distance, Hard Edge Angle, Normal Calculation Method.
capabilities.inputs: Merge Materials, Screen Size, Merge Distance, Hard Edge Angle

capabilities.does: OpenColorIO runs through an OpenColorIO Configuration Asset that references a .ocio file (OCIO v2 supported). It can apply to the viewport, Play in Editor via Blueprints, Movie Render Queue output, Composure inputs and outputs, and nDisplay clusters, frustums or nodes.
capabilities.inputs: OpenColorIO Configuration Asset, displays and views

capabilities.does: 3D Text Actor builds letter geometry from a TTF or OTF Font: Text, Extrude, Bevel, Bevel Type (Linear or Half Circle), Half Circle Segments, four materials (Front, Bevel, Extrude, Back), alignment, Kerning, Line and Word Spacing, Max Width/Height, Scale Proportionally.
capabilities.inputs: Text, Font, Extrude, Bevel, Kerning, Line Spacing

capabilities.does: Text3DCharacterTransform animates letters one by one with Enabled (per location, rotation, scale), Progress (0 to 100, keyed in a Level Sequence), Order (Normal, From Center, To Center, Opposite), Range (overlap between letters), Begin and End values.

Geometry Collection details have a Chaos Physics General group with Show Bone Colors, and a Materials list that repeats the source asset material slots so internal fracture surfaces can get their own materials.
capabilities.outputs: Internal surface looks for broken pieces

capabilities.does: Python Editor Script Plugin (plus Editor Scripting Utilities) embeds Python 3.11.8. Scripts run from the Output Log Python console, the py command, File > Execute Python Script, -ExecutePythonScript, a headless -run=pythonscript commandlet, init_unreal.py, or Project Settings startup scripts.

The unreal module mirrors what Blueprints expose, including plugins and project C++. snake_case functions, get_editor_property and set_editor_property, unreal.log, ScopedEditorTransaction for one undo step, ScopedSlowTask for progress. Editor only: not in Play In Editor or cooked builds.

Blueprint nodes Execute Python Script, Execute Python Command and Execute Python Command (Advanced) run Python from Blueprints, but only inside editor-only classes such as Editor Utility Widgets and Editor Utility Blueprints.

Landscape Sculpt mode lists Sculpt (raise, Shift lowers), Smooth, Flatten, Ramp, Erosion, Hydro, Noise, Visibility, Mirror, Region Select and Copy. It acts on the active Edit Layer, so edits stay non-destructive.
capabilities.inputs: Tool choice, brush style, falloff type

capabilities.does: The texture streamer raises and lowers the resolution of each texture to balance quality against memory. Docs sections: Texture Streaming Overview, Building Texture Streaming Data (with accuracy visualisation), Texture Streaming Metrics (stat commands) and Texture Streaming Configuration.

Sky Atmosphere settings: Ground Radius, Atmosphere Height, Rayleigh Scattering Scale and Exponential Distribution, Mie Scattering Scale, Exponential Distribution and Anisotropy (Earth-like 0.8), Absorption Scale and colour, Aerial Perspective View Distance Scale, and Transform Mode with three planet positioning options.
capabilities.inputs: Rayleigh/Mie scales, Mie Anisotropy, Absorption, Transform Mode

capabilities.does: A Directional Light becomes the sun or moon for the atmosphere with Atmosphere Sun Light and Atmosphere Sun Light Index (0 sun, 1 moon). Cast Cloud Shadows and Cast Shadow on Atmosphere let clouds shade the sky.
capabilities.inputs: Atmosphere Sun Light, Atmosphere Sun Light Index

capabilities.does: Volumetric Cloud component takes a volume Material and sets Ground Albedo (used with Ground Contribution), Reflection Sample Count Scale, Shadow Reflection Sample Count Scale, Shadow View Sample Count Scale, Trace Sample Count Scale and Use per Sample Atmospheric Light Transmittance.
capabilities.inputs: Material, Ground Albedo, Trace Sample Count Scale, Reflection Sample Count Scale

capabilities.does: Directional Light cloud shadow settings: Cast Cloud Shadows, Cloud Shadow Map Resolution Scale, Cloud Shadow Extent, Cast Shadows on Atmosphere, Cast Shadows on Clouds, Cloud Scattering Luminance Scale, Cloud Shadow Ray Sample Count Scale.
capabilities.inputs: Cloud shadow properties on the light

capabilities.does: Volumetric Advanced Material Output: Multi Scattering Approximation Octaves (0 to 2), Multi Scattering Contribution, Multi Scattering Occlusion, Ground Contribution, Ray March Volume Shadow (sharp coloured or Beer Shadow Map), Gray Scale Material and Conservative Density.

MetaHuman tools named: Creator (digital humans in the editor), Animator (animation from face and body footage), Crowds with LOD management, MetaHuman for Houdini (grooms), MetaHuman for Maya, Live Link Face with MetaHuman Capture on iOS and Android.

entries.name: CRYENGINE

rea.notes: The vendor page lists full source code as a feature, but the licence text was not read and the CRYENGINE GitHub repository page returned 404 to the fetcher, so source access is unconfirmed. The documentation site is public. Platforms come from the Wikipedia list of game engines, which also shows licence as Proprietary.

capabilities.does: The docs index has pages for Physically Based Shading (PBS), system setup for PBS, texture and material setup for PBS, and creating textures for physically based shading.
Image Based Lighting is a vendor-listed rendering feature, next to Physically Based Rendering.
The docs list an Environment Probe page and a Lighting Levels Using PBS page under Lighting.
Voxel-Based Global Illumination (SVOGI) has a docs page, with a separate page for a GI mode that works without voxels.
Area Lights are named as a lighting feature on the vendor features page.
Docs shadow pages: Per Object Shadows, Cached Shadows, Screen Space Shadows and Ray Traced Shadows.
Docs include Volumetric Fog and Procedural Volumetric Clouds pages.
Volumetric Fog Shadows is a vendor-listed rendering feature.
Real-Time Local Reflections is a vendor-listed feature.
Screen Space Directional Occlusion is a vendor-listed feature.
The docs list Height Map Based Ambient Occlusion and Analytical Occluders pages.
HDR Filmic Tone Mapping is a vendor-listed feature.
The docs index has a Post-processing page and a Tutorial - Color Grading page.
The vendor features page lists 3D HDR Lens Flares.
The vendor features page lists Motion Blur and Depth of Field together.
The docs index lists a Depth of Field Track for cinematics and an Anti-Aliasing page.
Tessellation and Parallax Occlusion Mapping are vendor-listed surface features.
Real-Time Dynamic Water Caustics is a vendor-listed feature.
The docs index lists Water Shader, Water Caustics, Terrain.Layer, Vegetation and Particles shader references.
Docs index: Particles, Key Concepts, GPU Support, a ParticleImposter Shader and the CryParticleSystem programming page.
Docs physics pages: Physics Features, Rigid Body Component, LocalGrids Component, Physics Constraint Components, NVIDIA PhysX, Posing Ragdolls and Physics Profiling.
The vendor features page lists built-in buoyancy and water simulation, various destruction models and advanced ropes under Physics.
VCloth 2.0 is a docs index page.

Docs index animation pages: Character Tool, Animation Events, Additive Animations, Blendspaces, Look IK, Ground Alignment, Weapon Aiming and Wrinkle Maps, plus a Mannequin editor with fragments, tags, transitions, scopes and layers.
The vendor features page lists Parametric Skeletal Animation, Procedural Motion-Warping and High-End IK Solutions, Geometry Cache, and Physicalized Character Customization.
A Blendshape/Morph page is in the docs animation list.
Trackview is the vendor-listed cinematic editor.
Docs audio pages: Audio Overview, Audio Middleware, and workflows for Wwise, FMOD Studio, ADX2 and SDL Mixer, plus Audio and Occlusion, Audio and Reverbs, Audio and Particles, and Audio CVars.
The vendor features page lists the Audio Controls Editor (ACE), Audio Abstraction, HRTF Audio Spatialization, Audio Components, Audio Occlusion and a Dynamic Response System (DRS).
Flow Graph is documented (overview, basics, debugger, modules, tokens) along with an experimental Schematyc editor.
Programming docs cover engine code, game code, a Game DLL, CryMonoBridge for C#, and creating a Flow Graph node as a C++ plugin.
VR docs list HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and OSVR, and a Stereoscopic Rendering page.
FBX Import Tools and an FBX Importer page are in the docs, with 3ds Max and Maya export guides and a Resource Compiler page.
Docs: Terrain, Terrain Layer Blending into Objects, Vegetation, and a guide to creating and importing a heightmap with World Machine.
The vendor features page lists Vegetation Touch Bending, where vegetation reacts to contact.
Substance Integration is a vendor-listed feature.

engines.does: Graphics engine of O3DE with material, shader and pass systems

engines.name: Atom Common Features gem
engines.does: Adds the Atom renderer and Material Editor, Forward+ capable

engines.name: PostFX
engines.does: Layered post-processing components and weight modifiers

engines.name: NVIDIA PhysX gem
engines.does: Rigid bodies, joints, colliders, character controller

engines.name: EMotion FX

engines.does: Visual scripting editor

engines.does: Node-based shader and material authoring

engines.name: Open Particle System
engines.does: Particle simulation and rendering

engines.name: Audio System
engines.does: Audio Translation Layer with middleware gems

engines.name: Multiplayer and AzNetworking
engines.does: Networked entities and packet layer

capabilities.does: Directional Light component: Color, Intensity mode (Lux or Ev100, default Ev100), Intensity (default 4.0) and Angular diameter (0 to 5 degrees, default 0.5) so highlights on smooth surfaces do not vanish. Groups for Shadow and Global Illumination.
capabilities.inputs: Color, Intensity mode, Intensity, Angular diameter

capabilities.does: Directional shadows use up to four cascades. Settings: Camera, Shadow far clip (100), Shadowmap size (256 to 2048), Cascade count (1 to 4), Automatic splitting with Split Ratio (0 linear to 1 log), Far depth cascade, Ground height, Cascade correction, Blend between cascades, Debug coloring.
capabilities.inputs: Shadowmap size, Cascade count, Split Ratio, Far depth cascade

capabilities.does: Shadow filtering options: Shadow filter method None, PCF, ESM or ESM+PCF; Filtering sample count (default 32); Shadow Bias, Normal Shadow Bias and Receiver Plane Bias cut acne; Fullscreen Blur with Strength (0 to 0.95) and Sharpness (0 to 400).
capabilities.inputs: Shadow filter method, Filtering sample count, Shadow Bias, Normal Shadow Bias, Fullscreen Blur

capabilities.does: Light component types: Point (sphere), Point (simple punctual), Spot (disk), Spot (simple punctual), Capsule, Quad and Polygon (up to 64 points, most expensive). Intensity mode: Candela, Lumen, Nit or Ev100. Quad and Polygon can emit from both sides.
capabilities.inputs: Light type, Intensity mode, Intensity, Both directions, Fast approximation (Quad)

capabilities.does: Per-light options: Attenuation radius (Automatic or Explicit, Radius in m), Shadows (spot disk and point sphere only) with Shadowmap size up to 2048, filter method, Pcf method (BoundarySearch or Bicubic); Shutters give Inner and Outer cone angles (0.5 to 90 degrees).
capabilities.inputs: Attenuation radius Mode, Radius, Shadowmap size, Pcf method, Inner angle, Outer angle

capabilities.does: Diffuse Probe Grid places a volume of probes that cast rays and store irradiance for diffuse GI. Probe Spacing X/Y/Z (default 2 m), Ambient Multiplier, View Bias, Normal Bias, Editor Mode and Runtime Mode: Real Time (Ray-Traced), Baked or Auto Select. Baking uses Bake Textures.
capabilities.inputs: Probe Spacing, Ambient Multiplier, View Bias, Normal Bias, Editor Mode, Runtime Mode

capabilities.does: Reflection Probe captures the surroundings into a cubemap: Inner Extents (Height, Length, Width), Parallax Correction, Show Visualization, Exposure, Bake Reflection Probe, Bake Exposure, Use Baked Cubemap and Baked Cubemap Quality from Very Low to Very High.
capabilities.inputs: Inner Extents, Parallax Correction, Baked Cubemap Quality

capabilities.does: Sky Atmosphere component sets planet and air: Ground radius, Atmosphere height, Rayleigh, Mie and Ozone scattering and absorption (with scales and exponential distributions), Aerial perspective, Sun colour, luminance, radius and falloff, Fast sky, shadows and sample counts.
capabilities.inputs: Rayleigh scattering, Mie scattering, Ozone absorption, Sun orientation, Min/Max samples

capabilities.does: Depth of Field component needs a Camera Entity. Properties: Quality Level (0 to 1), Aperture F (0 to 1), F Number (read-only), Focus Distance, Debugging; Auto Focus with Focus Screen Position, Sensitivity, Speed and Delay.
capabilities.inputs: Camera Entity, Aperture F, Focus Distance, Enable Auto Focus, Auto Focus Speed

capabilities.does: Bloom component: Threshold (default 1.0), Knee, Intensity, Enable Bicubic, Kernel Size Scale, five Kernel Sizes as shares of target width (0.04 to 0.64) and five Tints, one per bloom stage.
capabilities.inputs: Threshold, Knee, Intensity, Kernel Size 0 to 4, Tint 0 to 4

capabilities.does: SSAO component: Enable SSAO, SSAO Strength (0 to 2), Sampling Radius (0 to 0.25), Enable Blur, Blur Strength, Blur Sharpness, Blur Edge Threshold and Enable Downsample. It is on by default even without the component.
capabilities.inputs: SSAO Strength, Sampling Radius, Blur Strength, Enable Downsample

capabilities.does: Exposure Control: Control Type Manual Only or Eye Adaptation, Manual Compensation (-16 to 16 EV), and for eye adaptation Minimum and Maximum Exposure, Speed Up (default 3), Speed Down (default 1) and an Enable Heatmap histogram overlay.
capabilities.inputs: Control Type, Manual Compensation, Minimum Exposure, Maximum Exposure, Speed Up, Speed Down

capabilities.does: HDR Color Grading groups: Color Adjustment (Exposure, Contrast, Pre Saturation, Filter), White Balance (Temperature, Tint), Split Toning, Shadows Midtones Highlights, Channel Mixing, Final Adjustment (Post Saturation, Hue Shift), and LUT Generation (LUT Resolution, Shaper Type).
capabilities.inputs: Weight per group, Temperature, Tint, Hue Shift, LUT Resolution, Shaper Type

capabilities.does: PostFX Layer component sets Layer Category, Priority in Default (0 to 20), Weight and camera tag filters (Select Camera Tags Only, Excluded Camera Tags). The Atom component list also names Chromatic Aberration, Display Mapper, Look Modification and weight modifiers by gradient, radius and shape.
capabilities.inputs: Layer Category, Priority, Weight, camera tags

capabilities.does: Temporal Anti-aliasing is off by default; enable on PostProcessParent.pass. Parameters: m_currentFrameContribution (0.1 to 1, default 0.1), m_clampGamma (default 1.0) and m_maxDeviationBeforeDampening (default 0.5). Contrast Adaptive Sharpening can restore detail.
The Atom Common Features gem adds the Atom renderer and the Material Editor to projects, and the page states Atom supports Forward+ rendering.

StandardPBR material: Base Color (colour, texture, blend mode, factor), Metallic, Roughness (with Upper and Lower Bound), Specular Reflectance f0 (factor 0 to 1 maps to 0 to 8 percent), Normal, Opacity, Occlusion and UVs.
capabilities.inputs: Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Specular Reflectance f0, Normal

capabilities.does: StandardPBR includes a Clear Coat group, a thin translucent layer on top of the surface.
Subsurface Scattering simulates light travelling inside translucent surfaces before it leaves elsewhere.
Anisotropic Response controls direction-dependent lighting that stretches reflections across tiny grooves.
Displacement/Parallax uses a displacement map to fake bumps and offsets; the page names parallax occlusion mapping among the techniques.
Emissive simulates light given off by a surface.

The Material component works on Mesh and Actor components: Default Material, Model Materials per slot name, Enable LOD Materials with LOD Materials, a Generate/Manage Source Materials button, and the Material Instance Inspector for property overrides without a child material.
capabilities.inputs: Default Material, Model Materials, LOD Materials

capabilities.does: Material Canvas is a node editor for shaders and material types. Nodes from Constant, Input, Vertex, Function, Texturing, Scene and Utility categories feed Base PBR or Standard PBR output nodes, which generate shader files, a material type and a default material. Documents: .materialgraph, .materialgraphnode.

The Atom Developer Guide covers the Shader System with AZSL and the AZSLc compiler, a Shader Build Pipeline, the Material and Pass Systems, Render Pipelines, the Render Pipeline Interface and the Render Hardware Interface.
The Open Particle System gem provides particle simulation and rendering for special effects. The page defers details to a Particle User Guide.

Script Canvas is a node-based visual scripting editor. Node types: Event (EBus handlers), Action, Variable and data, Logic, Math, Debugging (not in release builds) and User-defined. Node Palette and Node Inspector panels are docked in the editor.

Lua scripting pages cover adding Lua scripts, script structure, the Lua Editor, math library, properties table, EBuses in Lua, the Lua environment and debugging; a Lua Script component attaches scripts to entities.
Python gems: Editor Python Bindings, Python Asset Builder (custom asset builders) and Qt for Python for tool UIs.
capabilities.outputs: Editor automation and custom asset builders

capabilities.does: NVIDIA PhysX components include Dynamic Rigid Body, Static Rigid Body, Shape Collider, Primitive Collider, Mesh Collider, Heightfield Collider and Force Region. PhysX configuration covers collision layers and groups, physics materials, scene queries and a debugger.
PhysX joint components: Ball Joint, Fixed Joint, Hinge Joint and Prismatic Joint.
PhysX Character Controller and Character Gameplay components provide character movement and physics response.
NVIDIA Cloth gem: cloth for Mesh and Actor components, per-vertex properties, simulation constraints and debugging. A PhysX Cloth component is also listed.

EMotion FX animation editor: Anim Graph with blend trees, Blend Spaces, state machines, motion sets, retargeting, ragdoll setup, simulated objects, actor LODs and morph targets; Actor, Anim Graph, Attachment and Simple Motion components.
The animation docs list Morph Targets as a topic of the Animation editor.
The Maestro Cinematics gem is listed under Animation gems; the docs also include Track View pages such as animating Depth of Field.

Terrain components (Terrain World, Layer Spawner, Macro and Detail Material, Physics Heightfield Collider) and Vegetation components (Layer Spawner, Blender, Blocker, filters by Altitude, Slope, Distance Between, Surface Mask; modifiers for Position, Rotation, Scale, Slope Alignment).

Audio System with an Audio Translation Layer, ATL default controls and an Audio Controls Editor; components for Listener, Proxy, Trigger, RTPC, Switch, Area Environment and Preload. Gems include Wwise, MiniAudio and Microphone.

AzNetworking covers packets, auto-packets, UDP encryption and serializers. The Multiplayer gem has auto-components, client and server separation, network entity hierarchies, player spawning and desync debugging.
UI Editor with canvases, elements, components, slices, sprite sheets and animation; UI canvases can be placed in the 3D world and on meshes.

Asset Processor, Scene Pipeline and Scene Source Assets turn source files such as FBX into runtime assets; Texture Settings, custom asset types and Asset Bundler produce release content. Packaging covers Windows release builds and content patches.
Robotics gems for ROS 2: Core, Controllers, Robot Importer, Sensors (Lidar, GNSS, Class Segmentation), Level Georeferencing and Simulation Interfaces.

engines.does: Node-based render pipeline configuration

engines.name: Effects and shaders

capabilities.does: Shaders use a language that extends HLSL with inheritance, mixins and automatic weaving of stage inputs and outputs. Effects use C#-like syntax to compose shaders into permutations. Shaders convert to HLSL for Direct3D or SPIR-V for Vulkan.
capabilities.inputs: Stride shader source (.sdsl) and effect files

capabilities.does: The Graphics Compositor is a node editor (experimental) for the pipeline: entry points Game, Editor and Single view, a forward renderer (opaque, transparent, post effects), a debug renderer, multiple cameras, render textures, HDR or LDR via Level 10 and Level 9 presets.
VR options are set in the forward entry node of the forward renderer in the Graphics Compositor.
Light components: point, spot, directional, ambient and skybox lights, plus light probes and light shafts. Only directional, point and spot lights cast shadows.

Shadow map size comes from LightShadowMap.Size (/8, /4, /2, x1, x2) on a shared atlas. Final size is a power of two from projected light size, capped by ShadowMapBaseSize (1024) times the factor. Directional lights make one map per cascade.

Voxel Cone Tracing GI needs Graphics Profile Level 11 or higher, the Stride.Voxels plugin and the Graphics Compositor (Voxel Cone Tracing) template. A Voxel volume entity and a Voxel light entity with a Light Volume reference provide the lighting.
capabilities.inputs: Voxel volume, Voxel light, Light Volume

capabilities.does: Post effects: Anti-aliasing, Fog, Outline, Ambient occlusion, Bloom, Bright filter, Color transforms, Depth of field, Lens flare, Light streaks, Local reflections. Depth-aware effects (depth of field, ambient occlusion, local reflections) disable MSAA.
capabilities.inputs: Property Grid of the graphics compositor

capabilities.does: Ambient occlusion properties: Samples, Projection scale, Intensity, Sample bias, Sample radius, Blur count, Blur scale, Edge sharpness and Buffer size.
capabilities.inputs: Samples, Sample radius, Intensity, Blur count, Buffer size

capabilities.does: Depth of field has Size (bokeh as a share of image width), DOF Areas (near blur, in focus, far blur zones), Technique (Circular Gaussian, Hexagonal Triple Rhombi, Hexagonal McIntosh) and Auto Focus on the screen centre.
capabilities.inputs: Size, DOF Areas, Technique, Auto Focus

capabilities.does: Color transforms chain at runtime into one shader and one draw call. Named transforms: Film grain, Gamma correction, ToneMap, plus Vignetting and custom color transforms in the post effects list.

Materials have maps, attributes (geometry, shading, misc including clear-coating shading), layers that combine several materials, and slots. They affect vertex and pixel shading and merge into model shading with lights and shadows.

Bepu Physics: collidables (Statics, Bodies, Kinematic Bodies, Characters), collider shapes, triggers, constraints, simulation configuration, and queries (raycasts, sweepcasts, overlaps). Bullet Physics is being phased out.
Skeletons and skinned models, animation clips, additive animation, procedural animation, custom blend trees, animation scripts, model node links and custom attributes.
Particle system sections: Emitters, Shapes, Ribbons and trails, Materials, Spawners, Initializers and Updaters.

Audio emitters and listeners give spatialised audio including HRTF. Also streamed audio, non-spatialised audio, importing audio, global audio settings, playing a range of a file, custom audio data and choosing an audio device.
Script base classes: StartupScript (Start, Cancel), SyncScript (Start, Update every frame, Cancel) and AsyncScript (Execute returning a Task, Cancel). Examples use C#.
Target platforms: Windows 10 and 11, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS. The editor runs fully on Windows, partly on Linux (via Wine) and not on macOS.

entries.name: Defold

licence.name: Defold License 1.0 (May 2020), derived from Apache 2.0: free use and commercial games allowed, but the editor or engine themselves may not be commercialised as a Game Engine Product

outcomes: 2D and 3D games for desktop, mobile, web and consoles

rea.notes: Source is public on GitHub (repository labelled Public). The licence page does not mention reverse engineering. It forbids commercialising the original or modified editor or engine as a Game Engine Product.
